text: At the Gathering, Yewstar offers a few tepid compliments to VoleClan's leader, who snorts. Does he really think these feeble words will close up the wound gaping between their Clans? (VoleClan relations unchanged.)
Yewstar feels extremely unsettled when Amberfur looks at him. (high negative effect)
